label_provenance.original: Explicit rubric, reviewed before inference; scripts/build_public.py states labelled before model calls.
label_provenance.hard: Authored with rationale; cross-model review before any system run. Model-assisted scenario authorship, not a claim of independent human annotations.
label_provenance.probability: gold_probs are derivable from explicit countable evidence; expected is the modal label, not a sampled observed outcome.

transport: Standard TLS-verified GitHub clone; checksums below are exact raw Git blob bytes, before checkout newline conversion.
unavailable_or_excluded_sources: Imported router and judge tasks with separate upstream terms
Public easy tier, outside the declared original+hard source cohort

default_eligibility.character_measure: Complete public request serialized as UTF-8 JSON text with ensure_ascii=false and compact separators; count Unicode characters.
default_eligibility.selection_basis: Input format/length only; no model predictions used.

upstream_scoring_contract.noul: Exact yes/no classification; maps no=false and yes=true.
upstream_scoring_contract.score: Integer ordinal level; scorer also computes ordinal expected value and exact argmax accuracy.
upstream_scoring_contract.ties: Upstream argmax uses lexicographically smallest candidate key; S1Q runner tie behavior must be reported separately.
upstream_scoring_contract.probability: Preserve original gold_probs separately from the hard modal label.
